children: Overview
Denmark cell counting instrument maker's annual revenue grew 3% yr/yr to DKK 511.1 mln
EBITDA rose to DKK 281.3 mln, driven by revenue growth and reduced staff costs
Company will not propose a dividend for the year due to ongoing share buy-back programme
Outlook
Chemometec expects 2026/27 revenue of DKK 545-575 mln
Company guides 2026/27 EBITDA in the range of DKK 300-315 mln
Chemometec to focus on marketing XcytoMatic products and expanding partnerships in 2026/27
Result Drivers
NEW PRODUCT SALES - Growth driven by increased sales of new instruments, especially XcytoMatic products
CUSTOMER AUTOMATION DEMAND - Increased demand for automation and integration solutions supported product sales
REGIONAL PERFORMANCE - Revenue growth in Europe and rest of world offset decline in USA/Canada

The current average analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 3 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the medical equipment, supplies & distribution peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Chemometec A/S is DKK650.00, about 26.2% above its September 9 closing price of DKK515.00
The stock recently traded at 38 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 29 three months ago
